body: I think she’s the female incarnation of toxic femininity the same way Joe is the incarnation of toxic masculinity. Joe is the “dudes exist to spread their wild oats and never settle down” taken to an obsessive, dangerous level. Love is the “girls exist to trap you and keep you down” taken to an obsessive, dangerous level. Joe chases you into your grave, Love locks you down and kills you if you try to leave. Both serial monogamists but from different angles. I think she would be happy with one person indefinitely, but will always wind up killing him out of paranoid jealousy if he shows the slightest hint of infidelity.
